title: Jack Mason, the Old Sailor
author: Francis C. (Francis Channing) Woodworth
description: "Jack Mason, the Old Sailor" by Theodore Thinker is a charming children's book written in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This narrative captures the adventurous tales of Jack Mason, an old sailor who regales children with stories of his experiences at sea, showcasing both his travels and the moral lessons learned throughout them.

authorInfo.bio: Francis C. (Francis Channing) Woodworth (1812–1859) wrote Stories about Animals: with Pictures to Match. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
